citations.desc: Attending veterinarian and adequate veterinary care (dealers and exhibitors).
citations.narrative:
Per the licensee, Male poodle (chip# 9000000000134873) obtained a wound from another dog in the exercise pen in a
fight yesterday. Per the licensee, the dogs had gotten along together for months before this without incident. He was
separated and started on Gentamicin 1cc, twice a day. The program of veterinary care (PVC) does not have instructions
on wound care and the attending veterinarian has not been contacted prior to the inspection.
His left hind leg has a swollen area with wounds, redness, and one wound on his outside thigh appears deep; when lightly
touched a thick discharge (pus) oozed out of the wound; the area was only lightly touched because the dog appeared to
react/pull away in pain when the area was touched.
Also, his right ear had dry crusted hair on the outside. The inside of the ear canal had a dark discharge with a bad smell
and the skin around the ear canal was very red.
The licensee must contact the attending veterinary (AV) promptly for treatment guidance on conditions that do not have
specific instructions for treatment in the Program of Veterinary Care. Ensure that this dog is seen and treated by the
attending veterinarian (AV).
***Ensure this is corrected by the end of Friday 6/26/2026
***Note: Communication with the AV has confirmed that a visit to the facility will be made on Friday morning 6/26/26 to
evaluate and treat this dog.

A record of treatment had not been started for Male poodle (chip# 9000000000134873) that is being given Gentamicin
under the skin twice daily after getting wounded in a fight on 6/24/2026. A medical record must be kept for any dog getting
a treatment and must include the ID, the problem, the name of the treatment, date of treatment, and dates and findings of
test/screenings/examinations Lack of a treatment record does not ensure that an animal is receiving its treatment as
indicated. Ensure to maintain medical records for dogs as required.
***Correct by 6/27/2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the licensee.
